notes.title: Bot Patrol Version 1.0.4 - Cloud Saves!
notes.content:
Hello avid puzzle friend!

I've added cloud save support to BotPatrol, which will automatically move your progress from local registry configuration into a cloud shareable file. Steam then does the rest!
Now you can pick up your progress on your new shiny favorite machine of choice!

Let me know how that goes and keep yourself pealed for some more levels coming up soon!

- amightydish

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 released
notes.content:
This is addressing some player feedback right after release!

Bugfixes

 fixed final achievement not to be triggered under certain circumstances
 fixed a wrong level name showing up
 fixed the player being able to go out of bounds when completing some levels
 fixed having to press enter twice under certain circumstances to enter a level 


Thank you for playing!

-j

notes.title: Even more pre-release updates!
notes.content:
Been working away through my bug list and knocked a few tricky ones on the head.
Build is live - find the change log below!

CHANGELOG 0.9.9.3 

optimizations
-
consolidated barrier lighting per barrier group to increase performance

bug fixes

fixed a bug where hammering Undo with active cranes could end up in broken states
fixed a bug where conveyors somethings push barrels into each other
fixed a bug where enemy drones would just run into barriers without care
fixed some holes in level borders
[/olist]

I also spent a little time to produce another launch trailer, have a peek if you like!

[previewyoutube=dXPzZNpBSMU;full][/previewyoutube]

Once again thank you for all the feedback you provided, be it as a curator, beta tester or friend!

-j

notes.title: More pre-release fixes and updates!
notes.content:
As we are closing in on the launch date, I've spent time on addressing player feedback and some missing features. Only about two weeks to go!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880151/dec2a9e1f04ce40879e40ed4ecbaede705e65f0e.png

Change-log for version 0.9.9.2 beta3

Features

 visual improvements on main menu
 added end game cinematic


Bug Fixes

 fixed bug in some levels that allowed player out of bounds
 fixed various bugs with nonsensical level layouts
 fixed Busy Bee achievement accidentally requiring 1000 instead of 100 cargo containers placed
 fixed Freedom achievement not triggering after the final level has been completed


And many more smaller polish items!


Thank you to everyone who had great suggestions, posted screenshots, test played the entire game!
Bot Patrol would not be the same without you!

More updates incoming, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Pre-Release fixes and updates!
notes.content:
Thanks to amazing community feedback I've focused on accessibility and quality of life updates in the last two days. The build just went life a few minutes ago!

Menu Improvements

 - added an Exit button to the main menu
 - fixed a bug that did not allow the Dpad to be used in menus
 - fixed a bug that hid the control glyph help bar in menus  


Game Settings Improvements

 - added sound and music volume controls
 - added a window mode for fullscreen/window/borderless setting


Accessibility controls

 camera shake can now be turned on/off in user settings
 glitch effects can now be turned on/off in user settings


There is plenty more to come until release day!
Thank you once again for anyone making BotPatrol the best game it can be by reaching out with comments and suggestions! 
-j
